instruction: Kayla has emailed me pictures of all trips we had together over the years. Which trip location has the most pictures?
notes: Three apps: supervisor, gmail, file_system. The evaluation requires exactly one gmail.Attachment update (the download) and no file modifications/removals, so the model downloads Kayla's single pictures archive once (download_attachment needs a file_system access token, hence file_system login), decompresses it, and lists the extracted directory recursively to count pictures per trip-location folder. Kayla's address is discovered via gmail.search_users; her thread is found with show_inbox_threads filtered by from_email and attachment=true, then show_thread/show_email expose the email and attachment ids. The answer location is an abstract runtime object (most-pictured-location) whose value is selected from the show_directory listing; supervisor-complete-task takes it as the answer parameter and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action. Usernames for gmail and file_system are the supervisor's email; the flag object encodes the boolean true for attachment/recursive filters.
